title: It won't look like a screen

series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 6 of 7

beats.vo: Your first time will not look like what you've seen on a screen — and that's good news.

overlay.text: Your first time won't look like what you've seen on a screen.

beats.visual_intent: Dim bedroom window at night, curtains, empty room. No people.

beats.vo: This is number six of the seven things nobody tells you; follow so you don't miss number one, it's the big one.
Six: there'll be pauses. Something will be awkward. Somebody might laugh.
beats.visual_intent: Slow, quiet moment: hands fidgeting, a pause. Hands only, no faces.

beats.vo: That's not it going wrong — that's what real looks like. The guys who panic are the ones expecting a performance.
beats.visual_intent: Ordinary real life, unpolished: an empty city street at dusk.

beats.vo: So walk in expecting real, not a highlight reel.
beats.visual_intent: Walking into something calmly: an open doorway with warm light.

beats.vo: Hold onto this: awkward is normal, and it passes.
Number five next — it's the one that takes all the pressure off you.
